# Mamdouh Aboammar

> Vibe coder, conversion copywriter, and founder of PrePilot LLC. Building autonomous agentic tooling, conversion infrastructure, and developer quality gates.

## Overview
Mamdouh Aboammar is a developer, conversion copywriter, and founder based in Dubai and the United Arab Emirates. His technical systems focus on agent governance, frontend quality gates, autonomous coding workflows, and high-performance conversion infrastructure.

## Core Projects & Flagship Systems
- [PrePilot LLC](https://prepilot-system-agency.space/): Conversion infrastructure and AI agent systems for the MENA region.
- [Agent Kernel](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel): Multi-agent orchestration kernel, policy engine, and deterministic agent execution framework.
- [AOS - Antigravity Omni-Agentic Superplatform](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/aos): Dual-loop cognitive orchestrator with AST blast-radius checking and verification gates.
- [Fable Code Lifecycle](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/get-fable): Bounded, evidence-based coding lifecycle for autonomous agents.
- [Taste-Skill Suite](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/taste-skill): Anti-slop design system enforcement, eliminating AI visual tropes and em-dashes.
- [Stop-Slop](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/stop-slop): Linter and pattern analyzer eradicating predictable AI writing tropes from software copy.
